bloques.titulo: Dating management in the health centre
texto: **Marcar uma consulta** = order or arrange a medical appointment.
**Cartão de utente** = official patient health card in Portugal.
**A médica de família** = the head doctor / family doctor.
Citations can be altered or cancelled by phone or presentially.

frases.pt: Bom dia. Gostaria de marcar uma consulta médica para esta semana.
frases.es: Buenos días. Me gustaría pedir una cita médica para esta semana.
frases.en: Good morning. I'd like to order a medical appointment for this week.

frases.pt: Bom dia, dona Sofia. A consulta com a médica de família é na terça-feira, às onze horas.
frases.es: Buenos días, doña Sofia. La consulta con la médica de familia es el martes a las once.
frases.en: Good morning, Mrs. Sofia. The consultation with the family doctor is Tuesday at 11: 00.

frases.pt: Perfeito. De que documentos preciso para o atendimento?
frases.es: Perfecto. ¿Qué documentos necesito para la atención?
frases.en: Perfect. What documents do I need for attention?

frases.pt: Chegue dez minutos antes da hora marcada e leve o cartão de utente do SNS.
frases.es: Llegue diez minutos antes de la hora acordada y lleve la tarjeta sanitaria del SNS.
frases.en: You arrive ten minutes before the agreed time and take the SNS health card.
analisis: e leve o cartão de utente

frases.pt: E se tiver algum imprevisto profissional?
frases.en: What if I had some kind of work-related thing?

frases.pt: Não se preocupe. A marcação pode ser alterada facilmente por telefone até à véspera.
frases.es: No se preocupe. La cita puede cambiarse fácilmente por teléfono hasta la víspera.
frases.en: Don't worry. The appointment can be easily changed by phone until the day before.

bloques.pregunta: What day and time is Sofia's appointment in the health center arranged for?

opciones.explicacion: The doctor's office is scheduled for Tuesday at 11: 00.
The outpatient has no routine early-morning consultations.
The appointment is scheduled for the same week.

bloques.pregunta: What official identification document should the patient provide when they come to the centre?

opciones.texto: O cartão de utente do SNS
opciones.explicacion: The user health card of the luso public system.

opciones.texto: O cartão de embarque de avião
A fatura da eletricidade de casa
opciones.explicacion: It does not provide evidence of the patient's health status.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the formal way of carrying.
bloques.frase: A utente deve chegar dez minutos antes e ___ o cartão de saúde.

opciones.explicacion: «Leve» is the peremptory form of «levar» (carry it with you).

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the participle that expresses modification.
bloques.frase: A consulta marcada com a médica pode ser ___ por telefone.

opciones.explicacion: feminine is in line with «a consulta» (changed or modified).

bloques.pregunta: What is the faithful meaning of this communication?
bloques.frase: A consulta com a médica é na terça-feira, às onze.

opciones.texto: The doctor's office is Tuesday at 11: 00.
opciones.explicacion: Reflects the appointment with the professional in the given day and time.

opciones.texto: The doctor cancels all week's work visits.
opciones.explicacion: There is no general cancellation of services.

opciones.texto: The pharmacy opens on Tuesday from 11: 00.
opciones.explicacion: It combines the medical center with a night pharmacy.

bloques.pregunta: In the Portuguese health system, what is a «utente»?

opciones.texto: A patient or user of the National Health Service
opciones.explicacion: It is the legal and daily name for SNS users.
He's a beneficiary, not a drug.
It does not indicate a physical stay.

bloques.frase: A marcação pode ser alterada por telefone
bloques.traduccion: The appointment can be changed by phone
bloques.explicacion: The appointment + can be + changed + by + phone.

intro: In the National Health Service (SNS) of Portugal, a medical appointment («marcar uma consulta») requires the presentation of the health card («cartão de utente») and to come in advance.
